about: CLAIM checklist map for the SchwingNet manuscript: the 42 items of the CLAIM 2020 checklist, verbatim from the docx at the repository root, each mapped to its evidence on disk or to the FLAGSHIP_PLAN.md gate that produces it.
claim_version: CLAIM 2020: Mongan J, Moy L, Kahn CE Jr. Radiol Artif Intell 2020;2(2):e200029; doi 10.1148/ryai.2020200029
version_note: The docx on disk is CLAIM 2020 (42 items; doi 10.1148/ryai.2020200029). sections/methods.tex line 111 states 'reporting follows CLAIM 2024', the update that reorganises the checklist (Tejani et al., Radiol Artif Intell 2024; doi 10.1148/ryai.240300). This file maps the docx on disk; at G7 either the citation moves to the 2020 paper or the 2024 checklist is obtained and this map is rebuilt from it.

disjointness_item21.corpus: C-ArmLSpine (the only intraoperative test set; the 98.2 % and every CV number)
disjointness_item21.disjoint_at: ACQUISITION SESSION (case). Not provably patient: PatientID empty on 59,307 of 59,609 instances, UIDs regenerated per file, 149 cases on five acquisition dates a median 224 s apart. ACQUISITION DAY after the folds are regrouped by day (lateral whole frame 92.5 % [87.7, 96.4] against 98.2 % case-grouped, SchwingNet/results/a9.json). Institution-disjoint from every training corpus for the zero-shot and LODO results.
SPECIMEN (six cadaveric pelves); test specimen 18-1109 has 0 frames in train or val.
CASE on the dataset paper's authority; centres D, F and G carry no identity remnant on disk; 74,364 cross-split near-duplicate pairs are different patients at the same gantry angle.
ONE OBJECT each (a resin phantom; one cadaver L1-L5); test only or card only; a split carries no information.

PATIENT (TCIA PatientID; one release id = one person verified 802/802 by two routes). The shipped allspine v2/v6/v7 banks split it by case NAME and put 357 people on both sides, so nothing from those banks is quoted.
SUBJECT in the spec (355 subjects over 374 series) but SERIES in the v8 bank (five people on both sides); no VerSe number is quoted.
SCAN. No patient identifier exists in either release; persons <= 1,935 and unknowable on disk. The device corpus holds 17 validation subjects fixed across every geometry and card.
PERSON (sample_id), but entered twice and split independently in v2/v6/v7 (48 of 54 validation patients leaked); withdrawn.
PATIENT (release patient_id, AP and LA together); two byte-identical pairs uncertain.
IMAGE, assumed to equal patient; untested.
STUDY (5,000) in the spec; IMAGE in the shipped vindrps bank; not quoted.
SOURCE DOCUMENT; trained the intraoperative fold banks only; never a test claim and never a patient count.

flow_item33: C-ArmLSpine: 149 cases released -> 148 built (1 failed conversion) -> 296 frames; fixed split md5(case) % 10: 105/15/28 cases; five-fold CV md5(case) % 5: test folds 35, 25, 28, 36, 24

C-ArmLSpine truth: 910 CBCT vertebrae compared -> 814 agreed (89.5 %), 41 name disagreements, 55 unmatched; SPINEPS missing on 3 cases; boxes 1,807 -> 1,623 with an agreed level (T11 0 of 3, T12 6 of 63)
C-ArmLSpine scoring: lateral 676 agreed vertebrae in 143 cases -> 617 detected in 141 (the 98.2 % denominator); AP 673 -> 631 in 142

COBRA2026 Elekta: 692 public cases -> 152 fetched (download-volume cut, no criterion; full fetch = gate G0) -> 145 in splits (B000 dropped: 41 frames the CT never covers) -> 110/8/27 cases (2,640/192/648 frames)
COBRA2026 Varian: 26 cases fetched (F 14, G 12); device-card fitting only
Geneva hip: 1 phantom, 116 frames, test only. Ljubljana: 1 cadaver, 18 frames, card only. SpineSAC: header census only, no result

CT rendered: CTSpinoPelvic1K 802 -> 801 (0533 truncated; rebuild = gate G0); TotalSegmentator v2 1,228 -> 1,170 rendered -> 142 clean whole-spine -> 17 fixed validation subjects; VerSe 374 series (355 subjects) -> 387 renders, none quoted
Plain film validation (patient-keyed v8 bank, SchwingNet/results/a5.json): CSXA 727 patients / 3,635 vertebrae; BUU-LSPINE 549 / 2,744; NHANES II 52 / 445
